name: Alistigo artifact — module composition
description: Conceptual model of the canonical module types that compose any alistigo artifact and their dependency relationships. Not a deployment or runtime view — this is the package/module dependency graph every artifact author should follow.

nodes.name: Domain
nodes.description: Pure, framework-free DDD domain model. Zero dependencies on other alistigo modules. Contains value objects, aggregates, commands, entities, errors, domain events, and repository interfaces. Defines the vocabulary and business rules of the artifact.

interfaces.description: Aggregate roots, domain commands, domain events, and repository interfaces.
Optional extension points for domain-specific plugins. Allows plugins to augment domain behaviour without the domain depending on any plugin.

metadata.isolation: zero project-internal imports — no UI, no IO, no DOM, no global state

nodes.name: Document
nodes.description: Owns the artifact's data model and application service. Provides event-sourced projections, the application service exposing all document actions, serializer/deserializer, and a validation function. Re-exports the Domain module so downstream consumers need only depend on Document.

interfaces.description: Application service, projections, serializer/deserializer, and domain re-exports.

metadata.scope: shared platform — one package used by all artifact Document modules

nodes.name: UI
nodes.description: Presentation layer. Contains React components that display and interact with the Document module. Every component has a Storybook story. Depends on Document; domain types are accessed via Document's re-exports.

interfaces.description: Exported React components mounted by the Artifact module. Components dispatch Document application-service commands and consume projections. Expose plugin UI slots.

metadata.storybook: every component has a Storybook story

nodes.name: Artifact
nodes.description: The artifact orchestrator — the top-level npm package. Composes Document and UI, wires in the shared platform modules, and sequences the startup lifecycle. Plugin injection happens here; Domain, Document, and UI are unaware of plugins.

interfaces.description: Shared startup lifecycle (useStartArtifact hook, phase state machine).
Plugin registration point. Accepts an array of AlistigoPlugin instances. Plugins are injected at startup.

nodes.name: Storage
nodes.description: Core alistigo storage service. Exposes a KeyValueStore-compatible API consumed directly by the Artifact module. Abstracts over concrete storage backends.

metadata.consumed-by: Artifact directly — wired into the Document layer at startup

nodes.name: Logger
nodes.description: Core structured logger. Provides a Pino-based logger instance for structured, leveled output.

interfaces.description: Structured logger API: info(), warn(), error(), debug() with log-level control.

nodes.name: Skill
nodes.description: A complementary npm package published alongside the artifact. Contains a SKILL.md capability definition consumed by AI agents, reference documentation, and an optional config JSON schema. Has no code dependencies.

interfaces.description: SKILL.md — the agent capability definition. Describes how an AI should generate, configure, and interact with the artifact.

metadata.consumed-by: AI agents and chat interfaces, loaded on demand from npm CDN

relationships.description: Document applies commands to domain aggregates and builds projections from domain events.
UI dispatches document commands and consumes projections. Domain types are accessed via Document's re-exports.
Artifact initialises and wires up the Document layer at startup.
Artifact mounts the UI component tree into the host DOM container.
Artifact resolves the active storage backend at startup and passes it to the Document layer.
Artifact uses the shared structured logger for runtime logging.
The artifact publishes a companion skill package as part of its package family.
